newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's 1996 real wages drop 3.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's 1996 real wages drop 3.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Monthly average real wages in Hungary's business sector fell 3.6 percent in 1996, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Friday.

The average net monthly wage from January to December for non-agricultural enterprises was 31,540 forints, compared with 31,040 forints in January-November -- 19.5 percent more in nominal terms than in the same period of 1995.
But average inflation for the whole of 1996 was 23.6 percent

Wage increases in 1996 in the services sector were above average while the processing and construction industries, wood and paper production and printing lagged behind other sectors. KSH figures are based on data from enterprises with more than 10 employees.

Gross wages of full-time employees in the business sector stood at 62,530 forints in December last year, showing a 19.8pc twelve-month increase, while the annual average of gross wages was 49,760 forints, 23.7pc up on the previous year.
